CADB.name: Cardless ATM Cash Disbursement
CADB.definition: Withdrawal is a cardless cash disbursement one.

CPLT.name: Completion
CPLT.definition: Transaction previously initiated is completed and contains the actual amount.

DBRP.name: Debt Repayment
DBRP.definition: Payment is a debt repayment one.

INCR.name: Incremental
INCR.definition: To authorise additional amounts for a previously authorised transaction.

FRCP.name: First Recurring
FRCP.definition: First occurence of a recurring payment.

PAUT.name: Pre Authorisation
PAUT.definition: Preauthorisation for an amount which is unknown at the time when the transaction is initiated and to be cleared within a specified timeframe.

PACP.name: Pre Authorisation Completion
PACP.definition: Financial completion of a pre-authorised transaction within a specified timeframe.

PPYT.name: Pre Payment
PPYT.definition: Payment in advance of receiving goods or services.

RCPT.name: Recurring Payment
RCPT.definition: An occurrence of a recurring payment..

SUBR.name: Subsequent Recurring
SUBR.definition: Subsequent occurrence of a recurring payment.

TPUP.name: Top Up
TPUP.definition: Service to replenish value in an account (for example, mobile account, prepaid account, etc.).
